register: Salvage Convention 1989 — Article 1 definitions + derived terms

definitions.text: any act or activity undertaken to assist a vessel or any other property in danger in navigable waters or in any other waters whatsoever

substantial physical damage to human health or to marine life or resources in coastal or inland waters or areas adjacent thereto, caused by pollution, contamination, fire, explosion or similar major incidents
definitions.note: Geographically limited: coastal/inland/adjacent waters — NOT high seas.

definitions.text: ten criteria (a)-(j) without order of priority
out-of-pocket expenses reasonably incurred + fair rate for equipment and personnel actually and reasonably used (criteria 13.1(h),(i),(j) in view)
